verdict.rationale: Workable documents webhook subscriptions that notify an external service when candidate events fire, with an args object to filter which events are received. That lets users build event-triggered automation, but only with their own external service or tooling acting on the notifications. The evidence shows no native in-product rules engine for defining trigger→action workflows. Missing for 10: native user-defined rule/workflow builder, in-product automatic actions on events (e.g., stage changes triggering emails or moves), documentation of rule conditions/actions, independent or hands-on corroboration.
